es_irpf_2025_state_general.title: Spain, IRPF, state scale of the general base (escala estatal, base liquidable general)
es_irpf_2025_state_general.source: Ley 35/2006, art. 63.1, as amended by Ley 11/2020 (in force since 2021, unchanged for 2025): https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2006-20764
es_irpf_2025_state_general.note: Only the state half: the regional (autonómica) scale of the taxpayer's community is added on top; give it as brackets.

es_irpf_2025_state_savings.title: Spain, IRPF, state scale of the savings base (base liquidable del ahorro)
es_irpf_2025_state_savings.source: Ley 35/2006, art. 66.1, as amended by Ley 7/2024 (from 1 January 2025): https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2006-20764
es_irpf_2025_state_savings.note: Only the state half; the regional half of the savings scale has the same brackets and rates.
